_note: An eval card in USD, fitted on 2026-10-25 from four streamed calls through the production Router. Both tier-balanced and tier-powerful served deepseek-v4-pro. A streamed response carries usage.cost, the vendor's own figure, and the measure uses it. A buffered response carries none, so the measure prices it with this card. The card reproduces each probe's cost within 1 percent. completion_tokens counts the reasoning tokens.

flash._note: deepseek-flash, for a call that --tier-map sent to tier-fast. USD per 1M tokens. Input and output are the Flash list prices (0.30 and 1.20 at peak, so half off peak, and the peak factor applies on top). The cache-hit rate is DeepSeek's off-peak list price (0.006 at peak), from https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/ on 2026-10-30. It prices only a call with no usage.cost.
